description: projects.getProject and projects.deleteProject (GET/DELETE /v9/projects/{idOrName}) omit the 404 response the live API returns for a missing project, so distilled's typed union lacks NotFound on both operations. The reconciler's observe step (getProject -> missing -> create) and the idempotent delete (deleteProject catching not-found) both branch on a typed NotFound tag; without it the 404 surfaces as the catch-all. Add the 404 responses so the generator attaches the status-class NotFound error to both operations.
